column1: # XRAY-L1M.tsv  — DERIVED, not fetched. 3p spin-orbit splitting.
# split = L1M3 - L1M2, from XRAY-L1M3.tsv and XRAY-L1M2.tsv, joined on (element, a).
# theory_split_eV is always defined. exp_split_eV is blank where either source
# WARNING 1: theory_split_eV is NEGATIVE at P, S, Cl and K — physically impossible
#   for a spin-orbit splitting. It is NIST's own theory column placing L1M2 above
#   L1M3 there. Those elements sit below the analysed region and must not enter a fit.
# WARNING 2: where blend = L1M2,3 the two source tables share ONE experimental
#   value, so exp_split_eV is identically 0 and carries no information. Excluded
#   on the database's own flag, per register 1391.
# Al and Si appear in L1M2 only and have no partner; they are absent here.
